expectations.evidence: MemoryChartPanel.createOrShow() calls vscode.window.createWebviewPanel('memoryChart', 'Memory Chart', vscode.ViewColumn.One, { enableScripts: true, retainContextWhenHidden: true, ... })

getHtml() includes <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; style-src ${webview.cspSource}; script-src 'nonce-${nonce}'; img-src ${webview.cspSource} https:; font-src ${webview.cspSource};">

Extension->Webview: this.panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'update', snapshot }) and { type: 'restore', dataPoints }. Webview->Extension: vscode.postMessage({ type: 'ready' }). Extension listens via this.panel.webview.onDidReceiveMessage(). Webview listens via window.addEventListener('message', ...)

media/style.css uses --vscode-editor-foreground, --vscode-editor-background, --vscode-font-family, --vscode-font-size, --vscode-badge-background, --vscode-badge-foreground, --vscode-inputValidation-warningBackground, etc. Also handles vscode-light, vscode-dark, vscode-high-contrast body classes

Webview uses vscode.setState({ dataPoints }) and vscode.getState() for persistence. Extension also registers WebviewPanelSerializer via vscode.window.registerWebviewPanelSerializer('memoryChart', ...) with deserializeWebviewPanel that calls MemoryChartPanel.restore()
getNonce() generates a 32-char random string. Used in CSP header as script-src 'nonce-${nonce}' and on the script tag as <script nonce="${nonce}" src="${scriptUri}"></script>
